items.title: Robinhood CEO Says Crypto Will Beat Sports at Prediction Markets' Own Game
items.summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says crypto event contracts are already outpacing sports bets, and could become the platform's dominant category within a few years.

items.title: ZetaChain Votes to Wind Down Layer 1 and Move ZETA to Solana
items.summary: Proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support and 58% participation, but exchanges must confirm the swap before a second vote sets the snapshot, claims and shutdown schedule.

items.title: Bitcoin could test $90,000 after shorts get squeezed, but traders warn leverage is building
items.summary: Bitcoin has broken out to $86,000, but analysts say the next leg depends on whether spot buyers continue to show up as leverage builds.

items.title: Saudi Arabia exits China-backed mBridge CBDC project: FT
items.summary: Saudi Arabia has left mBridge, a cross-border CBDC platform that has drawn scrutiny from US policymakers, according to the Financial Times.
